title: Operator-granted standing mandate: the live reviewer's recommendations on pkg-465a5d7d27644027 (ADA short) are applied AUTOMATICALLY by the VM rows watcher, every action class; scoped to that one package, expires when it closes. Build: mandates.yaml grant + per-package advice-only exception + watch reviewer row-write fix
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-29 ~07:40Z, verbatim: "I want to put a standing mandate for ltr lanes recommendations on this trade to be applied automatically". Popup answers, verbatim: scope = "Every action"; mechanism = "VM applies it directly". This IS the operator's grant (only the operator grants mandates; it is recorded here and the lane writes it into config/mandates.yaml under mandates:, quoting this note). BOUNDS that still bind (doctrine, not new gates): both brackets always exist (TP doctrine clause 3); a widen never puts the stop beyond the original entry risk (-1R) on real money (ML plan § 2a action-space rule); TP stays a live predictive target; Stage-2 equality: bybit_2 and bybit_portfolio move together; one action per package per bar; venue read-back on every leg; one Telegram ping per action. Interim until shipped: the 2-hourly watch continues and tightens come to the operator as popups. [2026-10-29 ~07:45Z] OPERATOR, verbatim (design constraint): "The reason for the current design that the lanes don't commit is so they don't need to read the repo to make a decision - we need to make sure the design doesn't increase latency on the round trip decisions". Consequence for build item (4): no system-action or reviewer-commit route (runner queues are 15-50 min). The watch cadence moves VM-SIDE: the VM wake poster emits an ltr-wake for each mandate-scoped open package on its cadence (2h, after the bar close), with the packet committed byte-exact BEFORE posting (as today); the reviewer is dispatched by reference with the packet inline and reads nothing from the repo; the rows watcher applies. Latency is MEASURED before and after (bar close -> packet commit -> marker -> row -> applied), and the build must not increase it.
